rows.grounds: locative plural compound indicating the Taittirīya recensions; fused form kept as one token
supplementary texts associated with Vedic branches
numeral specifying the count of supplements
conjunction adding to the preceding context

items.question: What number of supplementary texts belong to the Taittirīya branches?
premises: The Taittirīya branches are the locus named.
Supplementary texts are attributed to these branches.
The count of these supplements is specified as seven.
items.inference: There are seven supplementary texts in the Taittirīya branches.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the seven supplements is not named in this verse.
items.plain_english: And in the Taittirīya branches there are seven supplements.
